column1: # The shared playback screen's operator and accessibility copy, read by both shells.
# Nothing links the two, so `MonitorPlaybackCopyVectorTests` (Swift) and

# fails. Every `text` key must exist on both sides (Swift camelCase name; Kotlin the same name in
# UPPER_SNAKE_CASE), and every constant must have a row.
